summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'Mis cotizaciones' block for the Cuerpo Técnico (CT) role. TEST1 (CT on /mi-equipo 'Mi Club' view: cta-mis-cotizaciones-blocked present, cta-mis-cotizaciones link absent, cta-cotizar-blocked still present) PASSED. TEST3 (direct URL /mis-cotizaciones as CT shows mis-cotizaciones-gate with correct copy, no quotes list, back link to /mi-equipo works) PASSED. TEST4 regression (Directivo coach@test.com: cta-mis-cotizaciones is a working link, /mis-cotizaciones renders the normal history with new-quote-btn, no gate) PASSED. TEST2 (CT with own team_id) could NOT be executed with real data because the CT test account has team_id=null; verified by code review that MyTeam.jsx lines 782-792 use the identical conditional/testid/copy as the no-team view (lines 294-303).

issues: A tall (~600px) empty dark-navy band renders between the navbar and the 'MI CLUB / AUDITCLUB' header, pushing content below the fold. Looks like a hero/banner section without image or content for CT users - worth checking if intentional.

critical_code_review_comments: MyTeam.jsx duplicates the CT check three ways: a local `isCT` const (line 253) in the no-team view and two inline `(user.manager_role || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== 'cuerpo técnico'` expressions in the with-team view (lines 771, 782). MyQuotes.jsx repeats the same expression again. Extract a shared `isCuerpoTecnico(user)` helper/hook to avoid drift.

The CT restriction is UI-only. GET /api/quotes/mine is presumably still callable by a CT user (only the fetch is skipped client-side via `if (!isCT) reload()`). Enforce the role check server-side too, otherwise the restriction can be bypassed via the API.
MyTeam.jsx is 1388 lines; should be split into smaller components (club header, CTAs, roster, payments).
